sources.entry: 5. Paperspace - Cloud computing platform offering GPU accelerated virtual machines.

summary.name: Paperspace
summary.one_liner: Cloud GPU platform (now part of DigitalOcean) for training AI and machine learning models on NVIDIA GPUs, including H100s, on on-demand virtual machines.
use_cases: Training AI and machine learning models
Renting NVIDIA H100 GPUs on demand
Scaling training jobs without managing servers
summary.what_it_does: The page promotes Paperspace GPU compute for AI and machine learning workloads, including NVIDIA H100 GPUs. It offers on-demand pricing where users pay only for what they use, and says instance types can be changed at any time. Pre-configured templates are offered to start training models quickly. The page also mentions job scheduling, resource provisioning, automatic model versioning and tagging, and team features such as utilization visibility and permissions. Paperspace is now part of DigitalOcean, and the page points users there for the wider GPU lineup.
notable: On-demand GPU billing with instance types that can be changed at any time
Pre-configured templates for going from signup to training quickly
Gradient can run on any compute cluster (announced on the page)
caveats: Paid usage-based pricing; the page gives no specific prices
Page directs users to DigitalOcean for the current GPU product suite, so this page may be outdated
